def longest_consecutive(nums):
    num_set = set(nums)
    best = 0
    for x in num_set:
        if x - 1 not in num_set:  # only start counting at sequence starts
            length = 1
            while x + length in num_set:
                length += 1
            best = max(best, length)
    return best

print(longest_consecutive([100, 4, 200, 1, 3, 2]))
